content: We have also witnessed word or phrase level similarity to create alignment matrices between two sequences BIBREF0 , BIBREF1 . These alignment matrices has proved to be very useful to model the relationship between two word representations as well fuse the relevant information of one sequence into another. Empirical evidences have shown this alignment procedures have significantly performed better then simple concatenation or element-wise multiplication, especially for long sentences or paragraphs.
